title: Camera event change
description: A change of an event a camera reported over ONVIF, published on sss.<organisation>.<site>.camera.<camera>.event. Every change carries the whole event, so the event store creates the event from whichever change arrives first.

id.description: Event id, shared by every change of the event

kind.description: Event kind, such as motion or tamper

source_topic.description: ONVIF topic that caused the event

alert.description: Whether the event alerts; it only ever turns on

camera_time.description: The camera's own time of the event

details.description: The ONVIF messages and the camera's clock offset; merged into what is stored

snapshot_path.description: Snapshot relative to the events folder

thumbnail_path.description: Thumbnail relative to the events folder
